name: The Cottage
notes: From the Westport menus on the restaurant's own website (dinner, dessert, brunch, bar, wine, and liquor & spirits). The website lists no prices, and the restaurant says its menu changes with the seasons. Item names keep the menu's own wording; the Ten Year Tasting Menu tab had no text and is not included. The address was wrong on the old page (490 Post Rd E); The Cottage is at 256 Post Road East. Hours, phone and address from the website's Westport page.
taglineEn: Chef Brian Lewis's seasonal New American restaurant in Westport
taglineEs: Restaurante estadounidense de temporada del chef Brian Lewis en Westport
